_comment: Curated explanations for terms that ended mid-biennium (recalls, resignations, deaths). Keyed by person_id; each entry matches a term by its end date ('matches' when the source's end date is a verified artifact; the corrected 'end' is what gets persisted) and carries a human-verified label and reference link. An entry whose (person_id, end) matches no imported term fails the import. Never inferred.

ocd-person/f38798d5-c1a0-4dd6-a55c-7309a.label: Resigned after appointment as a Milwaukee County circuit judge
ocd-person/f38798d5-c1a0-4dd6-a55c-7309a.basis: verified 2026-08-22: Lena Taylor resigned effective Jan 26, 2024 when Gov. Evers appointed her to Milwaukee County Circuit Court Branch 41; the openstates end 2024-01-01 is a year-boundary artifact (her last recorded floor vote is Jan 23, 2024)

ocd-person/d5f588e5-d00f-4bdb-a64d-121af.label: Resigned to lead the Department of Administration under Governor Walker
ocd-person/d5f588e5-d00f-4bdb-a64d-121af.basis: verified 2026-08-22: Michael Huebsch was sworn in and voted on opening day Jan 3, 2011, then resigned to become Secretary of Administration; Assembly Journal Jan 3, 2011 p. 12 records the resignation honors; openstates end 2012-12-31 is a year-boundary artifact

ocd-person/f348bfc6-8e52-4b6b-b118-30e6d.label: Resigned to lead the Department of Transportation under Governor Walker
ocd-person/f348bfc6-8e52-4b6b-b118-30e6d.basis: verified 2026-08-22: Mark Gottlieb was sworn in and voted on opening day Jan 3, 2011, then resigned to become Secretary of Transportation (named Dec 30, 2010); Assembly Journal Jan 3, 2011 p. 12 records the resignation honors; openstates end 2012-12-31 is a year-boundary artifact

ocd-person/ff574a03-985b-4a20-ad85-c38ba.label: Resigned to join the Department of Natural Resources under Governor Walker
ocd-person/ff574a03-985b-4a20-ad85-c38ba.basis: verified 2026-08-22: Scott Gunderson resigned effective Jan 4, 2011 to become a DNR executive assistant; Assembly Journal Jan 3, 2011 p. 12 records the resignation honors; openstates end 2012-12-31 is a year-boundary artifact

ocd-person/4dfeb3fb-39b7-49a5-8323-b1c3f.label: Lost the August 2012 Democratic primary to Mandela Barnes
ocd-person/4dfeb3fb-39b7-49a5-8323-b1c3f.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Jason Fields lost the AD 11 Democratic primary on Aug 14, 2012 (Barnes 2,596 to Fields 1,206) and left office at the January 2013 inauguration; he won the seat back in November 2016. Attaches to his 2011-biennium supplement end.

ocd-person/72aa0b66-48f0-41fd-8ac8-b33f6.label: Did not seek reelection after his election as Mayor of Neenah
ocd-person/72aa0b66-48f0-41fd-8ac8-b33f6.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Dean Kaufert was elected Mayor of Neenah in April 2014, did not seek Assembly reelection that November, and served as mayor 2014-2022 before returning to the Assembly in 2025. Annotates his openstates end date.

ocd-person/5e70f623-ae29-4013-ac58-b86c2.label: Resigned to become Secretary of the Wisconsin Department of Revenue
ocd-person/5e70f623-ae29-4013-ac58-b86c2.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Peter Barca took the DOR oath Jan 7, 2019 and resigned his Assembly seat the same day, in office at DOR from Jan 8; matches the curated one-day 2019 term

ocd-person/2e0e6bb3-bb92-4b34-90bc-a22ff.label: Lost the November 2018 election
ocd-person/2e0e6bb3-bb92-4b34-90bc-a22ff.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Caleb Frostman lost the SD 1 general election to Andre Jacque in November 2018; his short term ended at the Jan 7, 2019 inauguration

ocd-person/798979da-9683-41b4-b663-d5c73.label: Won the July 2024 special election for Senate District 4
ocd-person/798979da-9683-41b4-b663-d5c73.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Dora Drake left her AD 11 seat when she assumed the SD 4 seat on Dec 19, 2024; the openstates Assembly end 2025-01-06 is a regular-term-boundary artifact

ocd-person/5e1693b6-c85f-4a65-af09-6f7d1.label: Resigned to join the Department of Agriculture, Trade and Consumer Protection under Governor Walker
ocd-person/5e1693b6-c85f-4a65-af09-6f7d1.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Keith Ripp resigned effective Dec 29, 2017 to become DATCP Assistant Deputy Secretary (started Jan 1, 2018); his last recorded floor vote is Nov 9, 2017; the openstates end 2016-12-31 is a year-boundary artifact (he was re-elected Nov 2016 and served through 2017)

ocd-person/6ed73b80-5a79-4731-a085-78a76.label: Resigned to join the Department of Workforce Development under Governor Walker
ocd-person/6ed73b80-5a79-4731-a085-78a76.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Frank Lasee resigned effective Dec 29, 2017 to lead DWD's Worker's Compensation division; his last recorded floor vote is Nov 7, 2017; the openstates end 2016-12-31 is a year-boundary artifact (he was re-elected Nov 2016 and served through 2017)

ocd-person/b2ad4345-9408-4238-a1f9-13e74.label: Lost the June 2012 recall election
ocd-person/b2ad4345-9408-4238-a1f9-13e74.basis: verified 2026-08-22: recalled June 5, 2012, lost to John Lehman by 819 votes after recount; returned by winning the redrawn seat in Nov 2014

ocd-person/a14523af-6b51-4c5b-95e5-98885.label: Lost the August 2011 recall election
ocd-person/a14523af-6b51-4c5b-95e5-98885.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Dan Kapanke lost the Aug 9, 2011 recall to Jennifer Shilling, who took the SD 32 seat on Aug 26, 2011; the openstates end 2012-12-31 is a year-boundary artifact

ocd-person/d91bccad-13b6-43ac-8e54-36fc6.label: Lost the August 2011 recall election
ocd-person/d91bccad-13b6-43ac-8e54-36fc6.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Randy Hopper lost the Aug 9, 2011 recall to Jessica King, who took the SD 18 seat on Aug 26, 2011; the openstates end 2012-12-31 is a year-boundary artifact

ocd-person/34a948bb-7d10-442e-97d5-dae4b.label: Lost the November 2010 election to Van Wanggaard
ocd-person/34a948bb-7d10-442e-97d5-dae4b.basis: verified 2026-08-24: John Lehman's first SD 21 stint ended at the Jan 3, 2011 inauguration after losing to Van Wanggaard in Nov 2010; the openstates row spans both his stints AND the Jan 2011-Jul 2012 gap between them, so its 2014-12-31 end is corrected to the first exit (the curated 2012 gap term and the labeled 2013 supplement carry the second stint)

ocd-person/34a948bb-7d10-442e-97d5-dae4b.label: Lost the November 2014 election to Van Wanggaard
ocd-person/34a948bb-7d10-442e-97d5-dae4b.basis: verified 2026-08-24: John Lehman won Wanggaard's seat in the June 2012 recall, then lost the redrawn-district rematch in Nov 2014; annotates his final Senate supplement

ocd-person/c8692ac4-68fe-4cf4-be7e-322bd.label: Resigned after his election as Dane County Executive
ocd-person/c8692ac4-68fe-4cf4-be7e-322bd.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Joe Parisi's AD 48 service ended April 14, 2011; he took office as Dane County Executive on April 18, 2011; the openstates end 2012-12-31 is a year-boundary artifact

ocd-person/3e9081cc-e630-4e59-9770-15eac.label: Resigned to join the Public Service Commission
ocd-person/3e9081cc-e630-4e59-9770-15eac.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Scott Suder resigned from AD 69 on Sept 3, 2013 for a Public Service Commission post; the openstates end 2014-12-31 is a year-boundary artifact

ocd-person/461ca9c3-6dff-40a6-820e-d3549.label: Resigned from the Assembly
ocd-person/461ca9c3-6dff-40a6-820e-d3549.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Mark Honadel's resignation from AD 21 took effect Sept 18, 2013; the openstates end 2014-12-31 is a year-boundary artifact

ocd-person/880ef838-0375-4df8-99c0-6347f.label: Resigned to join the Public Service Commission
ocd-person/880ef838-0375-4df8-99c0-6347f.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Jeff Stone resigned from AD 82 effective Oct 14, 2013 to become a PSC division administrator; the openstates end 2014-12-31 is a year-boundary artifact

ocd-person/67ecfe79-a3fa-4ed1-a6e7-a8c5a.label: Resigned to become Secretary of Agriculture, Trade and Consumer Protection
ocd-person/67ecfe79-a3fa-4ed1-a6e7-a8c5a.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Sheila Harsdorf's SD 10 resignation was effective Nov 10, 2017; she began as DATCP Secretary Nov 13, 2017; the openstates end 2018-12-31 is a year-boundary artifact

ocd-person/b58e5901-e3b6-49e1-869c-28497.label: Resigned after his election as Mayor of Racine
ocd-person/b58e5901-e3b6-49e1-869c-28497.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Cory Mason won the Oct 17, 2017 Racine mayoral special election and resigned AD 66 effective Jan 15, 2018; the openstates end 2018-12-31 is a year-boundary artifact

ocd-person/9196bcd2-4e71-4f25-869e-41bac.label: Died in office
ocd-person/9196bcd2-4e71-4f25-869e-41bac.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Bob Gannon (AD 58) died Oct 3, 2017 at age 58; the openstates end 2018-12-31 is a year-boundary artifact

ocd-person/8c8db3b7-0faf-4964-9166-4d742.label: Resigned after his election as Waukesha County Executive
ocd-person/8c8db3b7-0faf-4964-9166-4d742.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Paul Farrow represented SD 33 until July 17, 2015, resigning after winning the Waukesha County Executive race; the openstates end 2016-12-31 is a year-boundary artifact

ocd-person/8d93f6ba-19eb-4684-a47d-6de08.basis: verified 2026-08-24: Chris Kapenga left AD 99 when he took the SD 33 seat on Aug 6, 2015 (special election for Paul Farrow's vacancy, per his openstates Senate start); corrects his 2015-biennium Assembly supplement

ocd-person/13728fa5-9484-4767-b642-8bf9a.label: Elected to the Senate in a special election
ocd-person/13728fa5-9484-4767-b642-8bf9a.basis: verified 2026-08-24: John Jagler left AD 37 when he took the SD 13 seat on Apr 23, 2021 (special election for Scott Fitzgerald's vacancy, per his openstates Senate start); corrects his 2021-biennium Assembly supplement
